question: Where’s the closest museum positioned on the way to Gannon University, Erie, PA from the Lake House, East Springfield, PA?
sql: SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois AS p WHERE p.tourism ILIKE '%museum%' AND ST_Intersects( p.geometry::geography, ST_Buffer( ST_MakeLine( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Lake House%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%East Springfield%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ), ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Gannon University%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Erie%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 ) )::geography, 500 -- Buffer of 500 meters around the straight line path )::geography ) ORDER BY ST_Distance( p.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Lake House%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%East Springfield%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%PA%' LIMIT 1 )::geography ) ASC LIMIT 1;
